review.verdict_reason: T2 unsafe as written — routing all 7 OrderStatusChanged dispatch sites through DispatchKdsTicket would suppress legitimate OSS/FCM/loyalty consumers. Real defect is FE-side handler over-refresh, not BE dispatch site refactor. 3 of 4 plan-claimed P0s downgrade to P1.

findings.title: KdsSyncService /sync whereDate non-sargable
findings.evidence: whereDate('order_datetime', Carbon::today()) and whereDate('order_datetime', '<=', Carbon::today()) bypass idx_orders_datetime. Sibling /list hardened 2026-05-17 at KitchenDisplaySystemOrderService.php:94,100. Cache::remember 5s softens repeated cost but per-station 3-5s poll under WS_DEGRADED/DISCONNECTED amplifies linearly across fleet.
findings.impact: Full-table scan per poll; 50+ kiosks reconnect-storm = 100+ unindexed scans/min on orders table.
findings.heal: T1 — byte-mirror /list whereBetween + where < tomorrow pattern. EXPLAIN range scan acceptance.

findings.title: KDS Vue handler over-refreshes on non-kitchen OrderStatusChanged transitions
findings.plan_misframe: Plan claims 5 sites 'bypass DispatchKdsTicket gate'. Found 7 sites total. Each site has at least one legitimate non-KDS consumer (OSS list refresh via PreparingAndReadyComponent.vue:254-267, SendFcmOnOrderStatusChange, AwardLoyaltyPointsOnDelivery). Routing through DispatchKdsTicket::shouldDispatchStatusChanged (which only allows ACCEPT->PREPARING || PREPARING->PREPARED) would break OSS on CANCELED, suppress FCM on DELIVERED, suppress loyalty award.
findings.real_defect: KDS Vue subscriber refreshes on every OrderStatusChanged regardless of (from, to). The gate must live in JS, not in BE dispatch.
findings.heal: Rewrite T2 — FE-side filter at KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue:1762. Mirror KitchenReleaseRule::shouldDispatchStatusChanged semantics in JS. Skip _debouncedRefresh() when (old_status, new_status) is not a kitchen transition.

findings.title: OSS SYNC-2 budget compliant today but no fail-loud sentinel
findings.evidence: intervalMsWhenDisconnected hardcoded default 2000 ms (verified). PreparingAndReadyComponent.vue:248 early-returns branchId<=0 (no Echo on public wall). 2s ≤ 4s = half of SYNC-2 8s budget. No defect today; only regression risk.
findings.heal: T3 as written — sentinel asserting interval_ms_when_disconnected ≤ 4000.

findings.title: Echo channel-name contract works today, lacks regression sentinel
findings.evidence: Persisters write 'private-branch.{branchId}'. FE eventContract.js:337 builds channelName='branch.{branchId}' then window.Echo.private(channelName) auto-prepends 'private-'. Round-trip OK today. Rename on either side → silent zero events.
findings.heal: T4 + T9 — BranchChannelName helper at app/Events/Concerns/BranchChannelName.php (new namespace, non-frozen) + contract sentinel + E2E observe window.Echo.connector.channels keys.

findings.heal: T6 as written — replace TODO with comment citing Eloquent timestamps + OrderStatusTransition.occurred_at lineage ledger.

findings.evidence: KDS service hand-rolls lockForUpdate + branch-403 + expected_status 409 + recordTransition. apply() does first 3 of 4. 409 + branch-403 are KDS-specific UX.
